gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Simultaneous cost and schedule impact on this project routes first to the Owner's Representative per the delegation-of-authority letter, with the Electrical Engineer looped in as technical reviewer.
gold_routing_table.divergence_reason: Default discipline routing would keep this with the Electrical Engineer; this project's delegation letter pulls the owner's rep in whenever both cost and schedule are affected, regardless of discipline.

gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Field condition conflicts that are both urgent and schedule-impacting route directly to the GC Superintendent for immediate field resolution, unless the delegation-of-authority letter already pulled this to the Owner's Representative for a simultaneous cost impact.
Default discipline routing: the Electrical Engineer resolves this field condition; urgent status escalates the review but does not change who owns it since there is no schedule impact.
Default discipline routing: the Electrical Engineer resolves field condition conflicts affecting electrical work.
